user.title: Log in to EZVIZ
user.description: Use the account that owns the doorbell. Logging in once registers this Home Assistant as one EZVIZ terminal.

code.title: Verification code
code.description: EZVIZ sent you a verification code. Enter it here.

devices.title: Choose your doorbell
devices.description: Select the door station. For an HP7 or CP7 this is the entry marked BDoorBell.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in again
reauth_confirm.description: The login for {username} no longer works. Enter the current password.

error.invalid_auth: The account or password was not accepted.
error.invalid_code: The verification code was not accepted.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.
abort.no_devices: No devices were found on this account.

data.create_buttons: Create Open door and Open gate buttons

data_description.poll_interval: How often EZVIZ is asked for new rings. Shorter means a quicker notification.
data_description.create_buttons: Off by default. Leave it off while you keep using the buttons of another EZVIZ integration, so their entity IDs and your phone widgets stay as they are.

terminals_almost_full.title: EZVIZ terminal slots almost used up
terminals_almost_full.description: {count} of {limit} terminals are registered on this EZVIZ account. When all are used, new logins fail. Open the EZVIZ app, go to your account's logged-in devices and remove the ones you no longer use.
